top_contributors.detail: Congestion index at 100 — severe traffic flow degradation
Model-estimated risk score is in the critical range
High vehicle density increases collision exposure
Average speed of 19 km/h indicates near-gridlock conditions
4-week congestion trend is actively worsening — conditions deteriorating

explanation.assessment: This zone requires URGENT attention. Primary risk drivers: Congestion, Risk Score, Vehicle Density. Immediate field inspection and intervention planning recommended.

signal_optimization.reason: Severe congestion requires significantly extended green phase

interventions.name: Congestion Management & Diversion
interventions.description: Severe congestion with high vehicle density requires active demand management.
interventions.action: Activate dynamic message signs for route diversion. Consider congestion pricing or access restrictions.

interventions.name: Urgent Safety Inspection
interventions.description: Risk is actively worsening (high temporal trend) with already elevated risk score.
interventions.action: Deploy immediate field inspection team. Identify root cause of deteriorating safety conditions.

interventions.name: Traffic Signal Optimization
interventions.description: High congestion with low throughput speed indicates signal timing inefficiency.
interventions.action: Review and optimize signal timing at major intersections in this zone.

interventions.name: Red-Light Violation Enforcement
interventions.description: Elevated red-light violation count indicates intersection compliance failure.
interventions.action: Install or activate red-light enforcement cameras. Review signal visibility and timing.

interventions.name: Road Maintenance Inspection
interventions.description: Deteriorated road surface combined with elevated risk indicates infrastructure maintenance need.
interventions.action: Schedule road surface inspection and prioritize pothole repair, marking refresh, and drainage check.

interventions.name: Special Event Traffic Plan
interventions.description: Active special event generating additional traffic demand.
interventions.action: Activate event traffic management plan. Deploy traffic marshals and temporary signage.

executive_briefing: Zone_01 is in a critical safety state with 96% incident risk. Signal optimization recommended — congestion at 100/100 with speeds averaging 19 km/h. Optimizing signals could save 9600 kg CO2/week, equivalent to 23770 trees/year.

primary_collision_cause.title: Congestion Bottleneck & Merge Conflicts
primary_collision_cause.explanation: High vehicle density causes abrupt braking and sideswipe risks at merging points.

behavior_factor.title: Tailgating & Speed Variance
behavior_factor.explanation: Drivers following too closely during peak hours increase rear-end impact frequency.

for_drivers.details: Maintain 3 car lengths buffer during peak rush hours.

for_pedestrians_and_cyclists.details: Make eye contact with turning drivers at intersections before crossing.

peak_danger_windows.details: Congestion peaks during evening travel windows.
